description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with additional chaining capabilities for complex log processing pipelines. The class includes methods to set and get the next log node in a linked list and overrides the 'println' method to perform logging and propagate logs to the next node if present.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility to implement the 'LogNode' interface, enabling log message forwarding and chaining.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next 'LogNode' in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next 'LogNode' to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message to Android's logcat and forwards it to the next log node if available. Handles null messages and exception objects appropriately.
